artworks.title: Kylix of Hieron and Makron: the Judgement of Paris and the Abduction of Helen
artworks.description: On this Attic red-figure drinking cup, painted by Makron and signed by the potter Hieron and found at Vulci, the exterior unfolds the prelude to the Trojan War. One frieze shows the Judgement of Paris; the other shows Paris leading Helen away from Sparta. It is in this abduction scene that Timandra, sister of Helen and daughter of Tyndareus and Leda, makes one of her only securely identified appearances in ancient art: an accompanying inscription names her, and she is shown — in a chiton, mantle and fillet, arms flung outstretched — rushing forward to intervene as her sister is carried off, only to be held back by one of Paris's companions. The cup is one of the masterpieces of early-classical Athenian vase painting and is held in the Antikensammlung, Berlin (inv. F 2291).

artworks.title: Paris Abducting Helen (detail with Timandra inscribed)
artworks.artist: Makron (painter) and Hieron (potter); photograph by ArchaiOptix
artworks.description: Detail of the abduction frieze on the same Berlin kylix (Antikensammlung F 2291): the inscription TIMA(N)DRA names Helen's sister as she strains forward, arms outstretched, while a companion restrains her. Beside the departing pair stand Icarius and Tyndareus — the Spartan household watching Helen leave. This is the clearest surviving letter-perfect portrait of Timandra in Attic vase-painting.

artworks.title: Helen and Her Sisters (Meidias Painter hydria)
artworks.description: Attic red-figure hydria from the Kerameikos, Athens (inv. 2712): Helen sits brooding with Eros on her lap while her Spartan kin gather around her — Phylonoe, Hermione, Clytemnestra nursing Orestes, and the wider Tyndarid sisterhood. LIMC records Timandra among the named women of this upper zone, the second major vase on which Helen's less-famous sister enters the pictorial record of the house of Tyndareus. Below, maenads tear Pentheus; above, the cursed daughters of Leda share one quiet, doomed household.
